other_conditions: Applicant must possess a Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP ID).
Applicant must be a bonafide resident of Haryana.
Age relaxation may be given to the spouse accompanying the applicant.
The benefit can be availed only once every three years.
Attendant must be a bonafide resident of Haryana with a PPP ID.
Attendant facility may be availed by applicant over 80 years old on payment of 50% of railway ticket fare.
benefits_summary: The scheme fully covers rail travel and transport costs for senior citizens' pilgrimages, with reimbursement after journey completion.
